uxObservationsForIntegrationRequests.summary: Account color badges persist in WebView localStorage (multi-zalo.accountColors) across restarts on the same machine, but are not stored in profiles.json or backup.json.
When NTFS write permissions are denied, native Rust dim-cli/dim-desktop returns IO_ERROR (specific permission guidance), whereas dim-host.ps1 returns UNHANDLED_EXCEPTION (generic fallback message).
Tampered backup restore returns BACKUP_ERROR (safe SHA-256 rejection, zero .restore-* residue), whose UI string focuses on backup-while-open rather than corrupted backup archive.
